title: Chile
goal: Read how the 1973 coup against Allende ended in his death and Pinochet's seventeen-year rule, and how the regime's free-market "Chicago Boys" experiment outlasted the dictatorship itself.

items: Explain the debate over how Allende died.
Describe the junta's repressive apparatus under Pinochet.
Explain who the "Chicago Boys" were and what they did.
